verdict.rationale: The only on-axis evidence is CHKit's claim to describe, validate, test and deploy 'schema and pipelines as code', which implies the platform hosts pipelines but never says they run continuously or incrementally. The batch SQL task runner (pause/retry/cancel) is for one-off large operations, an adjacent feature that earns no credit for continuous transformation. Materialized views are never mentioned, and 'same SQL' compatibility cannot stand in for documented streaming or incremental capability. missing for 10: documented continuous or incremental transformation mechanism (materialized views, streams, scheduled tasks or continuous queries), detail on how pipelines execute and refresh, hands-on or independent corroboration.
